glosses: reservation, booking (arrangement by which accommodation or transport arrangements are secured in advance)
a reserve, reservation, preserve, sanctuary (area protected for a specific reason)

examples.text: Tú siempre reservas la misma habitación.
examples.en: You always reserve the same room.

examples.text: Por favor, reserva una habitación para ella.
examples.en: Please book a room for her.

examples.text: Tenemos una reserva para las seis y media.
examples.en: We have a reservation for six-thirty.
